Title: Beast goes crazy and finally joins the Camarilla!

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
(posting from Google just 'cause my cable modem setup is not quite
complete, so remote access to at&t's news server isn't viable yet..)

So, I remember way back in February '01 (google archive here:
http://groups.google.com/groups?hl=en&lr=&ie=UTF-8&oe=UTF-8&
selm=kzCg6.1839%24H_3.395083%40typhoon.ne.mediaone.net ), I posted a
little "challenge". The challenge was to get Beast, Leatherface of
Detroit, to join the Camarilla.
At the time, I think there was no possible way to do so.

But with the release of the CE, there is finally a way!
The new Derange allows a Malkavian to play it on Beast. So Beast can
become a Cam Malk, and you could even make him a Primogen (with Of
Noble Blood), or Malkavian Justicar! Wheee! :)

However, there's a problem, and a question:
Problem: Deranged Beast can't untap without burning the precious blood
he needs in combat. Oh well, the perils of being ugly *and* crazy.
Maybe he needs a permanent cell of his own in the Asylum Hunting
Ground. ;) But it could be fun for a Madness Network rush-combat
deck...

Question: Can Deranged Beast take the action to move Derange off of
himself onto another minion, or does this count as an "action card
action"?
If he becomes a Malk, is he stuck a Malk forever?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
> Question: Can Deranged Beast take the action to move Derange off of
> himself onto another minion, or does this count as an "action card
> action"?

He can. He could also take the action to burn an Army of Rats.

Action card actions are actions that begin by playing an action card
from your hand.
